Job Descriptions
1. Responsible for the textile fiber analysis testing, ensure the accuracy and timeliness of the report;
负责纺织品纤维成分的日常检测工作，保证报告的准确和及时；
2. Assist in the development of new methods and expand the scope of testing capabilities;
协助开发新方法，拓展检测能力范围；
3. Other related work in the laboratory.
实验室的其他相关工作。
Job Requirements
1. College degree or above, majoring in textile and chemistry;
大专及以上学历，纺织、化学相关专业；
2. Experience in animal fibers such as wool and cashmere, cotton and linen mixtures is preferred;
具有羊毛、羊绒等动物纤维，棉麻混合物的检测经验者优先；
3.Familiarity with domestic and international regulations on fiber composition
熟悉纤维成分的国内外法规；
4. Good team spirit and self-motivated
良好的团队合作精神，积极主动；
5. Good command of English, proficient in office software.
英语良好，熟练操作办公软件。
